query: Draw the workspace mat (a flat plane with a thin border) in a Z-up Three.js scene from this corner config (mm, robot base frame): {"top_left": [452.8, -240.0], "top_right": [135.8, -240.0], "bottom_right": [135.8, 102.0], "bottom_left": [452.8, 102.0]}
expected_behavior: The mat is drawn at 317 x 342 mm centred at (294.3, -69.0) mm (or meters equivalent: 0.317 x 0.342 m centred at (0.2943, -0.0690) m)
Computes bounding box extents across all 4 corner coordinates without assuming a fixed corner index ordering
Orients the plane flat on the table in the Z-up coordinate system

query: Write the Python side that exports a MuJoCo model's visual meshes for a Three.js viewer served by FastAPI, and the JavaScript that loads them and places them each frame from the body poses the server sends.
expected_behavior: Exports compiled mesh geometry (mesh_vert and mesh_face) rather than uncompiled raw CAD or STL asset files
Differentiates geoms by geom_type so primitive visual geoms (boxes, spheres, cylinders) are not exported as mesh assets
Caches exported assets keyed by model hash to prevent re-exporting on every request
JavaScript maps body transforms from MuJoCo coordinate convention (xpos and xquat wxyz to xyzw) onto Three.js scene groups

query: Write the Three.js frontend code that polls `/api/sim_state` (returns MuJoCo body positions and quaternions) about 30 times per second and updates the scene smoothly.
expected_behavior: Enforces an in-flight guard to prevent multiple concurrent HTTP poll requests
Drops stale out-of-order packets based on sequence number within the same session or epoch
Bypasses sequence check and snaps transforms immediately when reset_epoch or session_id changes
Updates a connection freshness indicator or triggers disconnect when responses stop arriving
